item.title: Help! Script face used by Duchamp...
item.description:
Any help appreciated tracking down the script used at bottom and left of Duchamp’s Obligations Pour La Roulette from the 1920s. It’s unfortunately either overlapping or cropped, which makes it challenging… See the full poster here: http://www.christies.com/lotfinder/prints-multiples/marcel-duchamp-oblig…
Thanks!
